regions.merged_text: A. REMARKABLE RAIN. M. Wade of St. Michael's Parish - Montgomery, Indiana enrolled said parish for good crops. At the time things looked very hopeless - really desperate. At once the rainy spring stopped. Corn, etc was planted and grew well but the drouth threat- ened. The parish was enrolled again that it might have rain. It did rain but to the astonishment of observers it only fell to the parish limits.
